# Secure Access to AI | AI Access Security

**Source:** https://www.zscaler.com/products-and-solutions/ai-access-security
**Captured:** 2026-08-12 via static first-party HTML extraction.

---

Zscaler positions AI Access Security as the surface for controlling access and
content across public generative-AI applications, AI embedded in SaaS,
AI agents, and developer tools.

## Product capabilities

- Discovers and classifies AI applications, including AI embedded in SaaS, and
  reports usage by users, departments, application trends, and at-risk data.
- Provides prompt and response extraction, classification, and usage insight.
- Applies user- and group-based access controls, including allow, block, coach
  or warn, and browser isolation with copy/paste controls.
- Applies inline DLP to prompts using more than 100 dictionaries, with examples
  including source code, PII, PCI, and PHI.
- Moderates prompts and responses for off-topic, restricted, toxic, or
  competitor-related content.
- Applies inline controls to AI IDEs and developer tools that access AI data
  and infrastructure.

## Evidence boundary

This marketing page establishes Zscaler's current product positioning and
named capability surface. It does not by itself establish a tenant's license,
feature entitlement, release stage, exact policy schema, or availability in a
particular cloud.
